paths.name: @phoenix/components/ai
paths.message: Do not import from the ai barrel within ai; use deep imports.

paths.name: @phoenix/components
paths.message: Do not import from the components barrel within ai; the barrel re-exports ai, so this closes a cycle. Use deep imports.

paths.name: @phoenix/components/chart
paths.message: The chart barrel imports the components barrel, which re-exports ai. Deep import the module you need, e.g. @phoenix/components/chart/SegmentChart.

paths.name: @phoenix/components/code

paths.message: The table barrel imports the components barrel, which re-exports ai. Deep import the module you need.
